packs.name: MINECON Founder's Pack
packs.description: Celebrate the 15th anniversary of Minecraft with this collection of capes, including the 15th anniversary Cape, the founder's Cape and more!

packs.name: Norse Mythology Bonus Skins
packs.description: Need a mini-horde of Vikings to get your midwinter festival started? Have these free Norse Mythology skins and party till Ragnarök. Skål!

packs.name: Minecraft Drops Skin Pack
packs.description: A collection of Java skins released alongside Minecraft game drops, featuring The Copper Age, The Garden Awakens, and Tiny Takeover: Mob Caretakers.

packs.name: Superman Skin Pack
packs.description: Skin up like a true Super Hero with the free Superman Skin Pack! Pick your favorite from five skins, including Superman, Lois Lane, Green Lantern, Hawkgirl, and even Mr. Terrific... suit up in a new skin today!

packs.name: Sonic the Hedgehog
packs.description: Sonic the Hedgehog races into Minecraft at supersonic speeds! Sprint, roll, and spring off enemies through iconic zones, with infinite gameplay. Master the thrilling abilities of Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, and more! Compete with friends for high scores. Unlock achievements, characters, new zones, and a challenging Eggman Mode! Includes popular skins.

packs.name: Hermitcraft Skin Pack
packs.description: Step into the vast and exciting world of Hermitcraft, download now and play as any of the 45 skins from your favorite Hermits!
